plan.title: Create and publish a Knockout auction

steps.note: Create the RFQ required before conversion to a Knockout auction.
Apply the RFQ pricing template before adding line items.
Add a line item required for the event.
Commit a bidding schedule before publishing.
Invite the available vendors required for publication.
Publish the initial RFQ so it can be converted.
Verify the initial RFQ became a published event.
Open the supported RFQ-to-Auction conversion flow, which exposes Knockout auction configuration.

args.goal: On the converted auction create screen, select the Knockout auction strategy, choose the entity on which offers are based, enter the Starting price, Tick Size, and time difference between consecutive offers, then save and publish the event; stop when the converted Knockout auction is published

steps.note: Perform the conversion-specific Knockout configuration and publication that no dedicated catalog step can express.
Assert that the Knockout auction reached a published project page.
Navigate to the Responses tab for the available oracle screen.
Verify the Responses screen rendered without errors or broken values.
